translation:
Forgetfulness (jianwang) — a turn of the eyes and it is already forgotten; with all one's strength of mind seeking, yet one cannot remember completely. In matters, from beginning to end, this is lost and that missed; in discourse, head and tail, one does not know to complete them.
The heart and spleen, from brooding care, labor to excess; the spirit not dwelling in its abode, treat its source. Heart blood not sufficient, phlegm leaves the orifice; Guipi Tangzi (Spleen-Restoring Beverage) may support and uphold.
Guipi Tang Yin (Spleen-Restoring Beverage) treats forgetfulness; Shen (Renshen/Ginseng), Qi (Huangqi/Astragalus), Shen (Fushen/Poria), Zhu (Baizhu) and Gui (Dang Gui) and Maimen (Ophiopogon). Yuanzhi (Polygala), Shipu (Acorus) and Longyanrou (Longan Flesh); if there be heat add some Shengdihuang (fresh Rehmannia).
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
Palpitation-with-apprehension (zhengchong), fright-throbbing (jingji) and terror (kongbu): the illnesses are the same in name but different, the pulses all deficient. For what a man presides over lies in the heart; what the heart nourishes lies in the blood.
Once the heart blood is depleted, the many illnesses arise; like a fish without sleep, no peace. Apprehensive, as if a man were about to seize oneself; Anshan Buxue (Settle-Spirit Nourish-Blood) oversees them all.
Anshan Buxue (Settle-Spirit Nourish-Blood), governing all deficiency; Siwu Tang (Four-Substances Decoction) adding Yuanzhi (Polygala) to nourish. Zhusha (Cinnabar) made sovereign, Shipu (Acorus) as messenger; palpitation-with-apprehension and such — all governed at once.
translator_notes: 怔忡=palpitation with apprehension; 驚悸=fright-throbbing; 恐怖=terror.
安神補血=Anshan Buxue; 四物湯=Siwu Tang.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
Urine flowing turbid, both white and red: white like rice-wash (water of washing rice), red like pus. The spleen and stomach, damp-heat, phlegm flows and seeps; returning into the bladder, the qi transforms and forms it.
It is like the temperate, harmonious season of heaven and earth; all still water settles to the bottom, thoroughly clear. When the weather is hot and sweltering, the water becomes mixed and turbid; the principle of damp-heat is clear and luminous.
There is also the one caused by failing to drain when one should drain; there is also the cause of wandering thoughts and sudden flashing (imagination). Further there is the clear-turbid with clinging silken thread and greasy; Bixie Fenqing Yin (Dioscorea Separate-the-Clear Beverage) may be sought.
Bixie Fenqing Yin (Dioscorea Separate-the-Clear Beverage) is most efficacious; Zhuling, Zexie and Chifuling (red Poria). Shipu (Acorus), Yuanzhi (Polygala) and Cheqianzi (Plantago Seed); Maimen (Ophiopogon), Gancao (Licorice) and Dihuang (Rehmannia) steamed.
translator_notes: 便濁=turbid urine; 萆薢分清飲=Bixie Fenqing Yin.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）
